title: Shine 125 SP (Classic Heritage)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda Shine 125 SP (Classic Heritage) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 125cc powertrain delivering 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 108 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
